meta.title: Toggle Form View and Table View
gaps: Assert that Table View has exactly and only the three columns Question, Description, and Vendor Response.
Fully verify that Form View renders each question in form layout rather than merely showing the questionnaire section.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Assert that Table View has exactly and only the three columns Question, Description, and Vendor Response.; Fully verify that Form View renders each question in form layout rather than merely showing the questionnaire section.

steps.note: Open the eRFX create screen for the RFP questionnaire setup.
Provide the mandatory event title for the create flow.
Configure the event with an RFP technical stage.
Work on the RFP stage where Basic Details questions are configured.
Apply an available RFP template containing the questionnaire sections.
Populate the technical questionnaire so Basic Details has at least one question.
Confirm the Basic Details questionnaire section is present before changing views.
Switch the Basic Details questionnaire to Table View.
Check that the Table View exposes the Question column label.
Check that the Table View exposes the Description column label.
Check that the Table View exposes the Vendor Response column label.
Switch the questionnaire back to Form View.
Confirm the questionnaire remains present after returning to Form View.
